options.label: A
options.textMd: certain that the revised route will ultimately be rejected.

options.label: B

explanationMd: The narration presents the new measures as matching the public concerns. It endorses a broader evaluation while withholding a verdict on the route itself.

distractorRationale.d: Neither fraud nor a guaranteed survey outcome is suggested.
